Search rebuild optimizations are complete: full suite passed (`247 passed, 4 skipped`); 10,000-document benchmark reached median 2.41s. CSV export was fixed to explicit UTF-8; exporter tests passed (`24 passed, 0 failed`). Quebec QST tax correction is now the priority.
